query: Which explainability and uncertainty tools (saliency maps, layer-wise relevance, SHAP for feature models, MC-dropout, ensembles) provide actionable, human-interpretable diagnostics for audio hate detection?

response.query: Which explainability and uncertainty tools (saliency maps, layer-wise relevance, SHAP for feature models, MC-dropout, ensembles) provide actionable, human-interpretable diagnostics for audio hate detection?
response.answer: SHAP and MC-dropout provide actionable diagnostics for audio hate detection. SHAP offers feature importance, while MC-dropout estimates uncertainty. Ensembles combine models for robust predictions.
